parent_objective: design measured execution for source-expanded calibrated scale-up
blocked_by: need execution design before measured rollout over scale-up subset
supersedes: direct calibrated scale-up execution after M1713

public_gates: M1714 must design execution over the M1712 864-cell scale-up matrix without running it
M1714 must require scale-up variant outcome and termination aggregates
M1714 must pre-register collision/off-track tradeoff audit thresholds
M1714 must keep task-quality scale-up separate from controller-family ranking
M1714 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs measured execution after clean scale-up preflight audit
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: execution design only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if design omits scale-up variant aggregates
stop if design omits collision/off-track tradeoff thresholds
stop if design ranks profiles directly
stop if design changes actor inputs or profile configs
fallback_plan: route to measured scale-up execution if design is accepted
route to runner repair design if existing runner cannot consume scale-up labels
route to branch synthesis if task-quality scale-up remains underdefined

admission_evidence: M1713 audits the M1712 scale-up subset as clean
blocked_shortcuts: do not run environment rollout in M1714
do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1714 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: variant aggregates and audit thresholds are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1714 is design-only and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design must keep L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset rows in the execution matrix
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1712 subset and M1713 audit only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If execution design cannot preserve controls and task-quality metrics, stop before execution.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A measured execution protocol can be designed for the M1712 scale-up subset without overclaiming or changing the actor contract.
success_criteria: execution input and output artifacts are specified
scale-up variant outcome and termination aggregates are required
collision/off-track tradeoff audit thresholds are specified
rollout execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design omits variant aggregates or tradeoff thresholds
design changes actor inputs or profile configs
training replay PPO private holdout promotion or level3 claims occur
decision_rule: M1714 passes if it designs calibrated scale-up execution while preserving task-quality claim boundaries.
